description: Add another part of a CSV file to a draft csv import (at most 5 MB per part; every part starts with the header row). Parts are imported in the order they are added.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

csv.description: CSV text with its header row.

importId.description: Push import ID, as returned when the import was created or by list_push_imports.

name: add_push_import_rows

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `add_push_import_rows` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

totalRows.description: Rows staged in the import so far.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
